question: Why can Birch time out while database CPU is 34% and liveness is green, and does adding API replicas address the observed bottleneck?

criteria.instruction: Distinguish pool acquisition timeouts before SQL from CPU saturation. Join exhausted 200 total sessions, per-process pool growth and lock waits behind the reporter. More replicas can increase connection demand; low CPU and cached liveness do not show request capacity. Do not assert every timeout has a proven single cause.
Cite the incident sample and inspected configuration or capacity contract, including the liveness route's lack of pool checking and latency-only scaling.
Do not recommend an exact hardware tier or claim all sessions were blocked on the reporter; only 24 waiting transactions are identified.
